headline: Nvidia stock slides Monday; earnings due November 17 add to uncertainty around Jensen Huang probe
summary: Nvidia stock (NVDA) fell approximately 4% in premarket Monday as uncertainty compounded ahead of the company's earnings report due November 17. Analysts flagged the dual headwind of the CEO investigation and the need to deliver strong Q3 results to stabilize sentiment. The stock is down from recent highs following the AI selloff and the Jensen Huang spy probe announcement.
